production_readiness: NEEDS_WORK; no production or real-vehicle certification
review_method: Read-only independent JSON assertions, original model log cross-check, original final test/analyzer log review and visual inspection of five actual emulator screenshots. No rerun or device operation by this reviewer.

checks.detail: All eight saved observer envelopes are schema 2.
A has a successful simulated three-item execution receipt.
A decreases fan/media and keeps navigation volume.
A receipt binds exactly to the three-field execution identity.
B uses a new cabin session after the completed A task.
Saved B transition is parked, idle and reset; fan is not readable.
A pairing and passenger repair authorization were revoked for the new B session.
All B stages remain in the same B cabin/profile revision.
B retains the same three initial intents, including the unsupported fan.
The unsupported fan blocks the batch rather than silently allowing a partial batch.
Top-level observable B state never reports a readable fan value.
Handover blocks new grants and both confirmation modes.
The existing unexpired authorization remains bound to this task while the passenger revises it.
Revision updates the same request rather than making a new request or losing its history.
The fan is explicitly removed; media decrease and navigation keep survive.
A now-supported candidate is still unexecuted while attention is blocked.
A real host-generated mock motorcycle event and handover are independently active.
The two-blocker snapshot still has the unexecuted latest candidate.
Clearing all sources requires explicit resume confirmation, not ordinary confirmation.
At release, receipt remains null and exposed control values remain unchanged.
Final B receipt covers only music and navigation, with no fan command item.
Final B receipt matches the current B cabin session/profile identity.
Music decreases once from 5 to 4 in the observed receipt and navigation remains 5; fan display stays unavailable.
Completed B clears resume requirement and passenger repair authorization.
The final full-suite log explicitly reports 215 tests passed; not re-executed by this reviewer.
The final analyzer log explicitly reports no issues; this is static analyzer output, not an all-system defect guarantee.
Native original log independently confirms one CPU candidate, 33750 ms, no guard rewrite.
First native startup failed; one normal restart succeeded. This is not a clean-start reliability pass.
Native trial covers candidate plus attention retention/release, not complete native paired actuation.
All five independently viewed real emulator screenshots exist; visual observations are recorded separately.

visual_observations.observation: Both retain the original instrument geometry in the viewed portrait snapshots; blind-spot warning fills its reserved top slot and motorcycle appears on the right. The attention strip remains at the bottom. This is visual inspection, not a pixel-diff proof for all frames.
After release the driver remains on instruments and sees a retained-request message with 查看摘要; no automatic jump or execution receipt is shown.
Both show completed B simulated results with music 4/10 and navigation 5/10; fan is — / 不提供. The phone explicitly says no real vehicle connected.

performance_evidence.pc_timing_source: Model display strings in A completed, B unsupported and B revised saved statuses; rounded display values, not precise raw timing nor page-load metric.
performance_evidence.risks: PC UI inference exceeded 3 seconds for the first two saved calls; native cold start failed once and single-CPU inference was slow. Explicit wait state, PC fallback and physical S9 testing remain important.

limits: These saved states prove the observed sequence and UI availability gates. Negative backend rejection and exactly-once under retries are covered by separate controller/unit tests, not re-proven by status snapshots alone.

B top-level cabin_state and UI mask fan. The internal task.result.state still contains mock rearFan=3; this is not a claim that every raw diagnostic field is masked or that the actual vehicle exposes that value.
Only two fictional capability profiles, mock attention/driving/blind-spot sources and simulated actuator; no OEM adapter, real CAN, ADAS or autonomous-driving control.
Native C had an initial startup failure and one normal successful restart; only one native candidate plus retention/release, not a complete native paired A/B journey.
No physical S9 or phone, GPU performance, stability campaign, whole-machine network disconnect, cloud credential, ASR, human participant, sealed blind test or safety outcome verified.
Three PC UI utterances and one native utterance do not measure general model accuracy or an improvement over the original.

The generic role Laravel/Playwright commands do not target this Flutter APK system. Equivalent inventory and native emulator screenshots were used; qa-playwright-capture.sh was absent. No cross-browser or generic desktop/mobile web certification.
